2.title: Putting business analysis in everyone’s hands
2.author: The Replit Team
2.description:
Today, we’re announcing that Replit has acquired Atta, bringing its approach to business analysis and high-quality, purpose-built charting into Replit.



Our mission is to make useful intelligence accessible to everyone. For businesses, that means giving the people closest to a problem the ability to investigate it, explain what they find, and act on their expertise.

Product leaders understand their customers. Marketing teams understand their channels. Sales and Revenue Operations teams understand their pipeline. But answering questions with data often requires translating that knowledge into an analysis request, waiting for the results, and repeating the process for every follow-up question.

We believe business intelligence should work differently. Anyone should be able to begin with a question, explore the answer, and put what they learn to work without needing a separate set of technical tools.

Atta shares that belief. Together, we’re building toward a future in which analysis is part of the work itself, not a separate destination.

3.title: Zero to MVP
3.author: Replit Blog
3.description:
Since joining Replit, I’ve faced a harsh truth—I’ve never written a line of code.



As a UC Berkeley student studying business journalism, coding feels out of reach. I’ve had countless app ideas but would always hit the same wall: Who can build this for me?



That’s until I discovered Replit. It's a platform that brings ideas to life fast—no technical background needed. Replit bridges the gap between creative vision and actual execution.

Making Ideas Happen

4.title: SpotHero: Innovation through Rapid Prototyping
4.author: Replit Blog
4.description:
SpotHero: Innovation through Rapid Prototyping

With Replit Teams, the SpotHero marketing team has developed internal tools, data integrations, and prototypes to seamlessly and cost-effectively integrate disparate departmental systems.

“Rapid prototypes that don’t tie up product and engineering teams with unproven methods are vital for innovation. Replit enables us to cycle quickly, helping us determine which projects are worthy of greater effort from our limited internal teams and which should continue to run departmentally.”

SpotHero overview

SpotHero is the leading parking reservation marketplace that helps drivers find, compare, and reserve parking across 300+ cities in the U.S. and Canada. Since being founded in 2011, SpotHero has helped drivers park over 75 million cars.
